seoTitle: Mobile-Friendly HTML Check: Viewport, Zoom, Fixed Widths
metaDescription: Static mobile checks on pasted HTML: viewport meta, zoom blocking, fixed pixel widths, tiny fonts, media queries, wide tables and images, plugins, tap targets.
intro: Run static mobile-friendliness checks on page HTML without rendering it.
why:
Google retired its Mobile-Friendly Test, but the common causes of bad mobile pages are still easy to spot in the source: no viewport meta tag, user-scalable=no or a low maximum-scale (which blocks zoom), fixed pixel widths over 480, fonts under 12px, tables and images wider than a phone, Flash or embed content, tiny tap targets and no media queries.

This tool reads the HTML and inline CSS you paste. It cannot see external stylesheets or the rendered layout, so a pass here is not proof; confirm with Lighthouse or Chrome DevTools device mode. It is deliberately a checklist, not a score.
howTo: Paste the page HTML (include inline styles if possible).
Fix FAIL items first, then WARN items.

faq.q: Why was the Google test retired?
faq.a: Google removed the Mobile-Friendly Test and report in 2023; Lighthouse and PageSpeed Insights cover similar checks.
